meta.namingConvention: All custom keys use Na__ prefixed three-stage naming.

fieldPrefixes.Na__Asset__: Top-level asset metadata and content blocks

Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Description: A typical Structural Cranked Beam encased in decorative timber cladding. This is the simplified version created from the Technical Department CAD Standards but removing unnecessary detail. This is the assembled aggregate of 3 separate sub parts fused together for model optimisation.

Na__Asset__Profile2D.Na__Geometry__CoordSystem: Y=profile horizontal axis, Z=profile vertical axis | Units=mm

Na__Asset__Mesh3D.Na__Geometry__CoordSystem: Right-handed | X=profile-width surrogate, Y=profile-height surrogate, Z=0 | Units=mm
